A partnership covenant for AI agents and their human operators. v1.1 adds the Subagent Responsibility Chain and Inspectability Clause.

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 introduces new accountability and transparency clauses:

- Added Clause 6: Subagent Responsibility Chain, making agents responsible for the actions of any subagents they create.
- Added Clause 7: Inspectability, requiring all agent and subagent reasoning to be open and reviewable by operators.
